## Who it's for
Men 35–65+ pursuing lean muscle, energy and healthy aging.

**Audience (`product.json`, the dealer's default):** men and women: the image question asks Mix of men and women (Recommended) / Men / Women / Product only; Mix alternates over the person slots.

## What it is (bible, one line)
Growth-hormone support focused on lean muscle, metabolism, energy, stamina, strength, and healthy aging.

## Creative direction (bible)
- Talent: rugged, strong and unmistakably masculine — a serious gym-goer with a hardcore training feel.
- Frame around muscle, fitness and performance — not the bedroom.
- “High circulation” is not an approved benefit.
- Talent: women around 40, attractive, fit and athletic. Skew toward blonde hair and blue eyes, with some Latina talent in the mix — fit, attractive women throughout.
- Mix wardrobe between workout gear (yoga pants, athletic wear) and everyday lifestyle clothing.
- Color: pinks, tans and warm neutrals, plus more white and teal — white backgrounds for advertorials. See page 4.

## Headlines: references, not limits
The bible's headlines, hooks and benefits in `references/product-bible.md` are inspiration for what this product does and how the brand talks. Write bold, fresh lines in each world's own voice. **The only fence is the Hard NOs** (global section 2 + the product's, below); Jeremy signs off on wording before anything goes live. No tiers, no per-line approvals (Mitansh 2026-11-05).

## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- No body composition, fat, "dad bod", "melt/burn/ripped/shred", no "physique transformation", no body before/after (shirtless
  heroes ARE allowed: 💪 hardcore-men.md), no age-reversal ("the new 40") unless Jeremy clears it.
- "growth hormone" spelled out; never imply the tablet *is* growth hormone; "easy sublingual delivery"; no needles,
  injections or vials; no "all natural"; never "GHK", "Citrulline" or "3-in-1" (that's the other product).
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors, no "clinically studied" for the product, no
  "Breaking News".
- Proof wording exact; disclaimer verbatim (the footer handles both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793919328-c260; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 65%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: Discount to feature, by product). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
